title: 第011章 什么叫捧杀第012章 学射继承牛角弓
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
老爷子到这时候，还担心着小儿子是不是一时气昏头，断了自己念想以后后悔。
李玄闻言，简直是哭笑不得。
他看看老爹，又看看哥嫂，知道他们是被原主之前的“痴情”
形象荼毒太深。
一时半会还转不过弯来。
他弯腰捡起柴刀，插回腰间，走到屋檐下，提起那只差点引起风波的山鸡，语气认真地说道：
“爹，大哥，嫂子，你们听好，我是真不在乎那徐玉莲了。
以前是我眼瞎。”
他顿了顿，脸上露出讥诮：
“你们还没看出来吗？就她们家那做派，舔着脸要一百两聘礼，还要我入赘改姓？她们怎么敢的？真当自己女儿是公主下凡了？”
“这说明什么？说明她们一家子，‘配得感’强得没边了！”
“总觉着自家闺女就该配上这天底下最好的，别人给什么都是应该的，给少了就是看不起她们。”
“配得感是什么意思？”
“对啊老三，你现在怎么文绉绉的……”
“哎呀，这不重要，别理她们了。”
他掂了掂手里的山鸡：
“我今天把价码喊到天上去，又当众翻脸把事情做绝。
以后，她们再想用这套算计别人，或者再跟人提亲时，别人就会拿我李玄今天的事掂量掂量。”
“‘哦，徐家啊，就是那个敢开口要一百两金玉还嫌不够，逼得李家老三差点砍人的那家？’”
“我这就是‘捧杀’！

把她们捧得高高的，再狠狠摔下来！
看她们以后还敢不敢这么厚着脸皮漫天要价！”
这一番话，说得李忠和王氏面面相觑，仔细一想，似乎……真是这个道理？
李山浑浊的老眼里也慢慢泛起了了然的光芒。
他看看儿子平静而透彻的眼神，又想想徐家母女今日的嘴脸。
终于，长久以来压在心口的那块关于“小儿子会被徐家女拖累死”
的大石，彻彻底底地松动了，滚落了。
“臭小子……”
李山哑声骂了一句，摇摇头，转身往屋里走，背影却透出一股松快，
“心眼倒是多了……吃饭！”
李秀儿眨巴着大眼睛，虽然不太懂“配得感”
和“捧杀”
但她听明白了三哥是真的不要那个坏女人了，立刻甜甜地应道：
“哎！
吃饭！
今天有山鸡！”
晚上，山鸡的油脂在陶罐里滋滋作响，浓香如实质般漫出破屋，勾动着全村人肚里的馋虫。
李家人围坐，一碗糙米饭，几块金黄的鸡肉，便是乱世里最踏实的丰年。
那山鸡最终被王氏料理得淋漓尽致。
肥厚的鸡油被炼出来，留着日后炒菜，金黄喷香。

鸡肉连同干菇、几片老姜、一小撮粗盐，在陶罐里用小火慢慢煨着。
汤汁从一开始的清亮逐渐转为诱人的乳白，油脂化作点点金圈浮在表面。
content_en:
At this time, the old man was still worried that his youngest son might get mad and regret it later.
When Li Xuan heard this, he couldn't laugh or cry.
He looked at his father, then at his brother and sister-in-law, knowing that they were "infatuated" by the original owner.
The image is too poisonous.
I still can't turn around for a while.
He bent down to pick up the hatchet, put it back in his waist, walked under the eaves, mentioned the pheasant that almost caused a disturbance, and said in a serious tone:
"Dad, eldest brother, sister-in-law, listen up, I really don't care about Xu Yulian anymore.
I was blind before. "
He paused, with a sneer on his face:
"Haven't you seen it yet? Just like their family, they lick their faces and ask for a hundred taels of bride price, and they want me to change my surname when I get married? How dare they? Do they really think that their daughter is a princess who has descended to earth?"
"What does this mean? It means that their family's sense of deservingness is extremely strong!"
"I always feel that my daughter deserves the best in the world. She deserves whatever others give her. If you give her less, you look down on them."
“What does deservingness mean?”
"Yes, Third Brother, why are you so polite now..."
"Oh, that's not important, just ignore them."
He weighed the pheasant in his hand:
“Today I screamed the price to the sky, and then I turned against everyone and got the job done.
In the future, if they want to use this method to scheme against others, or propose marriage to others, others will weigh what I, Li Xuan, did today. "
"'Oh, the Xu family, the one who dared to ask for a hundred taels of gold and jade, but it was not enough, and forced the third son of the Li family to almost kill someone?'"
"This is what I call 'praising and killing'!
Lift them up high and then throw them down hard!
Let’s see if they dare to be so shameless and ask for high prices in the future! "
These words made Li Zhong and Wang look at each other in confusion. After thinking about it carefully, it seems... is this really true?
Li Shan's turbid old eyes slowly glowed with understanding.
He looked at his son's calm and penetrating eyes, and then thought about the faces of the Xu family's mother and daughter today.
Finally, the question that had been weighing on my heart for a long time was about "the younger son will be dragged to death by the daughter of the Xu family"
The big boulder was completely loose and rolled down.
"Smelly boy..."
Li Shan cursed hoarsely, shook his head, turned around and walked into the house, but there was a sense of relief in his back.
"I have a lot of thoughts...eat!"
Li Xiu'er blinked her big eyes, although she didn't quite understand "the sense of deservingness"
and "Praise to kill"
But she understood that the third brother really didn't want that bad woman anymore, and immediately responded sweetly:
"Hey!
Eat!
There are pheasants today! "
At night, the fat of pheasants sizzled in the clay pots, and the strong fragrance spread out of the dilapidated houses like substance, swaying the gluttons in the stomachs of the whole village.
The Li family sat around, a bowl of brown rice and a few pieces of golden chicken, which was the most reliable harvest in troubled times.
The pheasant was finally cooked to perfection by Mr. Wang.
The thick chicken fat is extracted and kept for cooking in the future, making it golden and fragrant.
The chicken, along with dried mushrooms, a few slices of old ginger, and a pinch of coarse salt, are slowly simmered in a clay pot over low heat.
The soup gradually turned from clear at first to attractive milky white, and the oil turned into dots of gold circles floating on the surface.
